Three ways to deploy your assistant

On your premises in France

Nosia can be deployed directly on the client's premises in France, on hardware with a GB10 superchip. Sizing and operating conditions are scoped for your project.

In France with Scaleway

Documents and inference are hosted in France with Scaleway, a company governed by French law, without sending content to an external AI API.

In Switzerland with Infomaniak

Documents and inference are hosted in Switzerland with Infomaniak, a company governed by Swiss law. A distinct alternative to French hosting.

Support scoped together

A turnkey service is possible. We define the services that fit your deployment and your team with you.

Trust built on explicit choices

The Nosia software foundation is open source: its code can be inspected. For your project, we scope where data is processed, access and any connections to your tools.

Understand the Nosia foundation

The Nosia foundation offers an OpenAI-compatible API, document retrieval (RAG) and connections through MCP. Their implementation in your project depends on the agreed scope.

Your questions before getting started

How does Nosia differ from a consumer assistant?

The project starts with your business use cases and the content you choose to make available to the assistant. You choose the deployment, and the service scope is defined with you.

Where is my data processed?

Deployment can take place on the client's premises in France, in the French cloud with Scaleway or in the Swiss cloud with Infomaniak. Access, backups and any connections must be scoped for your project; location alone does not describe every data flow.

Do I need hardware or a technical team?

The on-site option uses hardware with a GB10 superchip. Cloud options provide a different deployment approach. Sizing and technical responsibilities are defined together; support is available.

Which services are included?

Installation, maintenance, updates, support and help with business use cases are available services. Their inclusion and scope are defined for your project, not assumed to be identical across deployments.

How do I choose a deployment and find out the budget?

We start with your use cases, content, confidentiality requirements and desired level of support. These inputs allow us to scope the deployment and budget for your project.

Can I use answers without checking them?

No. AI can make mistakes. Answers and content must be reviewed and checked before use, even when they draw on your documents.
